Re: Backended Runs out of heap space -- adjust backend RAM

You can set the environment variable SPARK_MEM and it should get picked up if you are directly including the package. If you are using sparkR-submit then you'll need to set the driver memory flag used by spark-submit.

Re: Backended Runs out of heap space -- adjust backend RAM

With the merge into Apache Spark we use spark-submit to configure the memory of the driver and executors. So I think this problem should not occur there. I'm marking this as fixed here and we can open a new issue at https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK in case this comes up again.
